query:
UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'Bryan Andrews (showrunner: A.C. Bradley)',
  `cast` = 'Jeffrey Wright as The Watcher, Chadwick Boseman as T''Challa / Star-Lord, Hayley Atwell as Captain Carter, Josh Brolin as Thanos, Michael B. Jordan as Killmonger, Samuel L. Jackson as Nick Fury',
  tagline = 'One question changes everything. The animated multiverse anthology that honored Chadwick Boseman.',
  description = 'What If...? Season 1 is an animated anthology series that explores alternate timelines in the multiverse, asking what would happen if major moments in the MCU occurred differently, narrated by The Watcher.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/what-if-s1-featured-4HvmtwEdvVDyttQvLP8Acy.webp',
  episodeCount = 9, seasonCount = 1, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = 94, rtAudienceScore = 79, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## What If Cards: The Variant Universe

What If cards feature unique alternate versions of beloved characters that don''t exist anywhere else in card form. **Captain Carter**, **T''Challa Star-Lord**, and **Zombie** variants are particularly collectible. Chadwick Boseman''s final Marvel performance as T''Challa Star-Lord gives those cards memorial significance.',
  keyCards = '- **2022 Upper Deck What If Captain Carter** — Fan-favorite new character, $8-20
- **2022 Upper Deck What If T''Challa Star-Lord** — Chadwick Boseman''s final performance, $15-40
- **2022 Upper Deck What If Zombie Cards** — Marvel Zombies variants, $5-15
- **2022 Upper Deck What If The Watcher** — Jeffrey Wright''s narrator character, $5-12',
  content = '## The Multiverse in Animation

What If...? brought the multiverse to life in ways live-action couldn''t — zombie Avengers, T''Challa as Star-Lord, Captain Carter, and an Ultron who conquered the universe. The animation freed Marvel from budget constraints and allowed truly cosmic storytelling.

## Chadwick Boseman''s Final Performance

The T''Challa Star-Lord episode stands as Chadwick Boseman''s final Marvel performance, recorded before his passing. It''s a joyful, funny episode that shows what Boseman brought to every role — warmth, charisma, and the ability to make you believe in heroes. His cards from this episode carry memorial significance.

## Captain Carter: From What If to Live Action

Hayley Atwell''s Captain Carter proved so popular in animated form that the character crossed over into live action in Multiverse of Madness. Her shield-wielding heroics in the show created a new fan-favorite that transcended the "what if" premise.

## Fun Facts

- Most original MCU actors returned to voice their animated counterparts
- The animation style was designed to look like moving concept art
- The zombie episode was so popular it spawned its own spinoff series (Marvel Zombies)
- Jeffrey Wright''s Watcher was originally meant to only narrate, not participate in the story
- The show confirmed that What If scenarios are canon multiverse timelines',
  metaDescription = 'What If...? Season 1 (2021) guide — multiverse anthology breakdown, Chadwick Boseman tribute, Captain Carter, trading card values, and the animated MCU.',
  keywords = 'what if marvel, captain carter, t''challa star-lord, chadwick boseman, the watcher, disney plus marvel, animated, marvel cards, multiverse',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel What If Captain Carter cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is What If canon to the MCU?","answer":"Yes, What If scenarios are confirmed as canon alternate timelines within the multiverse. Captain Carter has appeared in live-action, confirming these timelines exist within the MCU multiverse."},{"question":"Is this Chadwick Boseman''s last Marvel role?","answer":"Yes, the T''Challa Star-Lord episode features Chadwick Boseman''s final performance as T''Challa, recorded before his passing in August 2020."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'what-if-season-1-2021'
